name: wsproto
description: The WebSocket protocol (RFC 6455, with RFC 7692 compression) for client and server sessions, and ws:// and wss:// clients and servers over Haxe's own sockets, independent of application frameworks.
releasenote: Initial release: CrossByte's WebSocket protocol, for any host that moves the bytes, and clients and servers over Haxe's own sockets, ws:// and wss://, for any that does not.
